description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllSpHiraishin0]{Hiraishin no Jutsu}.

You carry a Hiraishin marker (typically a sealed kunai, a paper tag on your back, or a chakra brand pressed into a surface). The caster of Hiraishin can teleport to your square as a single action from up to 1 mile away.

You can refuse to be a teleport anchor with a free action (the marker remains, but the caster's next Hiraishin attempt fails harmlessly for 1 round).
